title: About location assets - Google Ads Help

facts.fact: Google's location assets help now covers 2 use cases, which the page lists as the former Location Extensions and Affiliate Location Extensions.
facts.quote: To make it easier for users, location assets now covers 2 use cases:

facts.fact: The former Location Extensions use case applies if the advertiser owns its store locations directly.
facts.quote: Used if you own your store locations directly.

facts.fact: The former Affiliate Location Extensions use case applies if the advertiser sells products or services in stores it does not own directly, including manufacturing and aggregating.
facts.quote: Used if you sell products or services in stores that you don’t own directly (this includes manufacturing and aggregating).

facts.fact: Store visit conversions are automatically enabled by Google when an account meets specific eligibility criteria, which the page does not enumerate.
facts.quote: Store visit conversions are automatically enabled by Google when an account meets specific eligibility criteria.

facts.fact: Location assets can enable store visit conversions, which track when ads lead to a visit to a physical store.
facts.quote: Location assets can also enable features like store visit conversions, which help you track when your ads lead to a visit to your physical store.

facts.fact: Location assets can also work with Performance Max campaigns.
facts.quote: Location assets can also work with Performance Max campaigns.

facts.fact: On Search, a location asset is eligible to show when people nearby search on mobile for the advertiser's keywords, and can display the distance to the location and its city.
facts.quote: when people nearby search on mobile for one of her keywords

facts.fact: For YouTube location assets, the store shown in the final ad is selected based on the user's location or a location they have shown interest in.
facts.quote: The store shown in the final ad is selected based on the user’s location or a location they’ve shown interest in.

facts.fact: Location assets can display the approximate travel distance to a store to help people find the advertiser's stores.
facts.quote: the approximate travel distance to help people find your stores.
